Bulbasaur.entry: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this Pokémon.

Ivysaur.entry: When the bulb on its back grows large, it appears to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.

Venusaur.entry: Its plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

Charmander.entry: Obviously prefers hot places. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

Charmeleon.entry: When it swings its burning tail, it elevates the temperature to unbearably high levels.

Charizard.entry: Spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. Known to cause forest fires unintentionally.

Squirtle.entry: After birth, its back swells and hardens into a shell. Powerfully sprays foam from its mouth.

Wartortle.entry: Often hides in water to stalk unwary prey. For swimming fast, it moves its ears to maintain balance.

Blastoise.entry: Once it takes in air, it holds it inside its shell, then releases it with great force using its abdominal muscles.

Caterpie.entry: If you touch the feeler on top of its head, it will release a horrible stink to protect itself.

Metapod.entry: The shell covering this Pokémon's body is as hard as an iron slab. Metapod does not move very much.

Butterfree.entry: In battle, it flaps its wings at great speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.

Weedle.entry: Often found in forests, eating leaves. It has a sharp venomous stinger on its head.

Kakuna.entry: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself from predators.

Beedrill.entry: Flies at high speed and attacks using its large venomous stingers on its forelegs and tail.

Pidgey.entry: Very docile. If attacked, it will often kick up sand to protect itself rather than fight back.

Pidgeotto.entry: This Pokémon flies over its wide territory in search of prey, downing it with its highly developed claws.

Pidgeot.entry: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as Magikarp.

Rattata.entry: Bites anything when it attacks. Small and very quick, it is a common sight in many places.

Raticate.entry: It uses its whiskers to maintain its balance. It seems to slow down if they are cut off.

Spearow.entry: Eats bugs in grassy areas. It has to flap its short wings at high speed to stay airborne.

Fearow.entry: With its huge and magnificent wings, it can keep aloft without ever having to land for rest.

Ekans.entry: The older it gets, the longer it grows. At night, it wraps its long body around tree branches to rest.

Arbok.entry: The pattern on its belly appears to be a frightening face. Weak foes will flee just at the sight of the pattern.

Pikachu.entry: When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity could build and cause lightning storms.

Raichu.entry: Its electric charges can reach even 100,000 volts. Careless contact can cause even an Indian elephant to faint.

Sandshrew.entry: It loves to bathe in the grit of dry, sandy areas. By sand bathing, the Pokémon rids itself of dirt and moisture clinging to its body.

Sandslash.entry: In an attempt to hide itself, it will run around at top speed to kick up a blinding dust storm.

Nidoran♀.entry: Although small, its venomous barbs render this Pokémon dangerous. The female has smaller horns.

Nidorina.entry: The female's horns develop slowly. Prefers physical attacks such as clawing and biting.

Nidoqueen.entry: Its hard scales provide strong protection. It uses its hefty bulk to execute powerful moves.

Nidoran♂.entry: Stiffens its ears to sense danger. The larger its horns, the more powerful its secreted venom.

Nidorino.entry: An aggressive Pokémon that is quick to attack. The horn on its head secretes a powerful venom.

Nidoking.entry: Its tail is thick and powerful. If it binds an enemy, it can snap the victim's spine quite easily.

Clefairy.entry: Its magical and cute appeal has many admirers. It is rare and found only in certain areas.

Clefable.entry: A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen. It will run and hide the moment it senses people.

Vulpix.entry: At the time of birth, it has just one tail. The tail splits from its tip as it grows older.

Ninetales.entry: It is said to live 1,000 years, and each of its tails is loaded with supernatural powers.

Jigglypuff.entry: Uses its cute round eyes to enrapture its foe. It then sings a pleasing melody that lulls the foe to sleep.

Wigglytuff.entry: The body is soft and rubbery. When angered, it will suck in air and inflate itself to an enormous size.

Zubat.entry: Forms colonies in perpetually dark places. Uses ultrasonic waves to identify and approach targets.

Golbat.entry: Once it strikes, it will not stop draining energy from the victim even if it gets too heavy to fly.

Oddish.entry: During the day, it keeps its face buried in the ground. At night, it wanders around sowing its seeds.

Gloom.entry: The smell from its drool-like syrup and the pollen on its petals is so bad, it may make opponents faint.

Vileplume.entry: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.

Paras.entry: Burrows to suck tree roots. The mushrooms on its back grow by drawing nutrients from the bug host.

Parasect.entry: A host-parasite pair in which the parasite mushroom has taken over the host bug. Prefers damp places.

Venonat.entry: Lives in the shadows of tall trees where it eats bugs. It is attracted by light at night.

Venomoth.entry: The powder on its wings is poisonous if it is dark in color. If it is light, it causes paralysis.

Diglett.entry: Lives about one yard underground where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears aboveground.

Dugtrio.entry: A team of Diglett triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.

Meowth.entry: Adores circular objects. Wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

Persian.entry: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.

Psyduck.entry: Always tormented by headaches. It uses psychic powers, but whether it intends to do so is not known.

Golduck.entry: Often seen swimming elegantly by lakeshores. It is often mistaken for the Japanese monster Kappa.

Mankey.entry: Extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment then thrashing away the next instant.

Primeape.entry: Always furious and tenacious to boot. It will not abandon chasing its quarry until it catches up.

Growlithe.entry: Very friendly and faithful to people. It will try to repel enemies by barking and biting.

Arcanine.entry: A Pokémon that has been admired since the past for its beauty. It runs agilely as if on wings.

Poliwag.entry: Its newly grown legs prevent it from running. It appears to prefer swimming than trying to stand.

Poliwhirl.entry: Capable of living in or out of water. When out of water, it sweats to keep its body slimy.

Poliwrath.entry: An adept swimmer at both the front crawl and breaststroke. Easily overtakes the best human swimmers.

Abra.entry: Sleeps 18 hours a day. If it senses danger, it will teleport itself to safety even as it sleeps.

Kadabra.entry: It emits special alpha waves from its body that induce headaches just by being close by.

Alakazam.entry: Its brain can outperform a supercomputer. Its intelligence quotient is said to be 5,000.

Machop.entry: It hefts a Graveler repeatedly to strengthen its entire body. It uses every type of martial arts.

Machoke.entry: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power-save belt to be able to regulate its motions.

Machamp.entry: Using its heavy muscles, it throws powerful punches that can send the victim clear over the horizon.

Bellsprout.entry: A carnivorous Pokémon that traps and eats bugs. It appears to use its root feet to replenish moisture.

Weepinbell.entry: When hungry, it swallows anything that moves. Its hapless prey is dissolved by strong acids.

Victreebel.entry: Lures prey with the sweet aroma of honey. Swallowed whole, the prey is dissolved in a day, bones and all.

Tentacool.entry: Drifts in shallow seas. Anglers who hook them by accident are often punished by their stingers.

Tentacruel.entry: Its 80 tentacles can stretch and contract freely. They wrap around prey and weaken it with poison.

Geodude.entry: Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.

Graveler.entry: Rolls down slopes to move. It rolls over any obstacle without slowing or changing its direction.

Golem.entry: Its boulder-like body is extremely hard. It can easily withstand dynamite blasts without damage.

Ponyta.entry: Capable of jumping incredibly high. Its hooves and sturdy legs absorb the impact of a hard landing.

Rapidash.entry: Just loves to run. If it sees something faster than itself, it will give chase at top speed.

Slowpoke.entry: Incredibly slow and sluggish. It is quite content to loll about without worrying about the time.

Slowbro.entry: The Shellder that latches onto Slowbro's tail is said to feed on the host's leftover scraps.

Magnemite.entry: Uses antigravity to stay suspended. Appears without warning and uses Thunder Wave and similar moves.

Magneton.entry: Generates strange radio signals. It raises the temperature by 3.6F degrees within 3,300 feet.

Farfetch'd.entry: The sprig of green onions it holds is its weapon. It is used much like a metal sword.

Doduo.entry: Its short wings make flying difficult. Instead, this Pokémon runs at high speed on developed legs.

Dodrio.entry: Uses its three brains to execute complex plans. While two heads sleep, one head stays awake.

Seel.entry: The protruding horn on its head is very hard. It is used for bashing through thick ice.

Dewgong.entry: Stores thermal energy in its body. Swims at a steady 8 knots even in intensely cold waters.

Grimer.entry: Made of hardened sludge. It smells too putrid to touch. Even weeds won't grow in its path.

Muk.entry: Thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.

Shellder.entry: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.

Cloyster.entry: For protection, it uses its harder-than-diamonds shell. It also shoots spikes from the shell.

Gastly.entry: Almost invisible, this gaseous Pokémon cloaks the target and puts it to sleep without notice.

Haunter.entry: Because of its ability to slip through block walls, it is said to be from another dimension.

Gengar.entry: Under a full moon, this Pokémon likes to mimic the shadows of people and laugh at their fright.

Onix.entry: Burrows at high speed in search of food. The tunnels it leaves are used as homes by Diglett.

Drowzee.entry: Puts enemies to sleep, then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating bad dreams.

Hypno.entry: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of PSI moves such as Hypnosis and Confusion.

Krabby.entry: Its pincers are superb weapons. They sometimes break off during battle, but they grow back fast.

Kingler.entry: The large pincer has 10,000-horsepower crushing force. However, its huge size makes it unwieldy to use.

Voltorb.entry: It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.

Electrode.entry: It stores electric energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.

Exeggcute.entry: The heads attract each other and spin around. There must be 6 heads for it to maintain balance.

Exeggutor.entry: Legend has it that on rare occasions, one of its heads will drop off and continue on as an Exeggcute.

Cubone.entry: Wears the skull of its deceased mother. Its cries echo inside the skull and come out as a sad melody.

Marowak.entry: The bone it holds is its key weapon. It throws the bone skillfully like a boomerang to KO targets.

Hitmonlee.entry: When kicking, the sole of its foot turns as hard as a diamond on impact and destroys its enemy.

Hitmonchan.entry: While apparently doing nothing, it fires punches in lightning-fast volleys that are impossible to see.

Lickitung.entry: Its tongue spans almost 7 feet and moves more freely than its forelegs. Its licks can cause paralysis.

Koffing.entry: Because it stores several kinds of toxic gases in its body, it is prone to exploding without warning.

Weezing.entry: When it inhales poisonous gases from garbage, its body expands, and its insides smell much worse.

Rhyhorn.entry: Its massive bones are 1000 times harder than human bones. It can easily knock a trailer flying.

Rhydon.entry: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

Chansey.entry: It walks carefully to prevent its egg from breaking. However, it is extremely fast at running away.

Tangela.entry: Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows nonstop even if they are torn off, making it tough to escape.

Kangaskhan.entry: Raises its young in its belly pouch. Won't run from any fight to keep its young protected.

Horsea.entry: If it senses any danger, it will vigorously spray water or a special type of ink from its mouth.

Seadra.entry: Touching the back fin causes numbness. It hooks its tail to coral to stay in place while sleeping.

Goldeen.entry: When it is time for them to lay eggs, they can be seen swimming up rivers and falls in large groups.

Seaking.entry: In the autumn spawning season, they can be seen swimming powerfully up rivers and creeks.

Staryu.entry: When the stars twinkle at night, it floats up from the sea floor, and its body's center core flickers.

Starmie.entry: Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value this core as a gem.

Mr. Mime.entry: If interrupted while it is miming, it will slap around the offender with its broad hands.

Scyther.entry: With ninja-like agility and speed, it can create the illusion that there is more than one.

Jynx.entry: It seductively wiggles its hips as it walks. It can cause people to dance in unison with it.

Electabuzz.entry: Electricity runs across the surface of its body. In darkness, its entire body glows a whitish-blue.

Magmar.entry: In battle, it blows out intense flames from all over its body to intimidate its opponent. This Pokémon's fiery bursts create heat waves that ignite grass and trees in its surroundings.

Pinsir.entry: If it fails to crush the foe in its pincers, it will swing around and toss the opponent.

Tauros.entry: After heightening its will to fight by whipping itself with its three tails, it charges at full speed.

Magikarp.entry: A Magikarp living for many years can leap a mountain using Splash. The move remains useless, though.

Gyarados.entry: In ancient literature, there is a record of a Gyarados that razed a village when violence flared.

Lapras.entry: Its high intelligence enables it to understand human speech. It likes to ferry people on its back.

Ditto.entry: When it spots an enemy, its body transfigures into an almost perfect copy of its opponent.

Eevee.entry: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.

Vaporeon.entry: It prefers beautiful shores. With cells similar to water molecules, it could melt in water.

Jolteon.entry: Every hair on its body starts to stand sharply on end if it becomes charged with electricity.

Flareon.entry: It stores some of the air it inhales in its internal flame pouch, which heats its body to over 1700 degrees Fahrenheit.

Porygon.entry: A Pokémon that consists entirely of programming code. Capable of moving freely in cyberspace.

Omanyte.entry: An ancient Pokémon that was recovered from a fossil. It swims by cleverly twisting its 10 tentacles about.

Omastar.entry: A prehistoric Pokémon that died out when its heavy shell made it impossible to catch prey.

Kabuto.entry: This Pokémon was regenerated from the fossil of an ancient creature. It protects itself with a hard shell.

Kabutops.entry: Its sleek shape is perfect for swimming. It slashes prey with its claws that can cut steel.

Aerodactyl.entry: It was regenerated from a dinosaur's genetic matter that was found in amber. It flies with high-pitched cries.

Snorlax.entry: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

Articuno.entry: A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.

Zapdos.entry: This legendary bird Pokémon is said to appear when the sky turns dark and lightning showers down.

Moltres.entry: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. It is said that its appearance indicates the coming of spring.

Dratini.entry: A mythical Pokémon of Chinese mythology. It is found swimming in seas and lakes. Its body shines in rainbow colors.

Dragonair.entry: A Pokémon that is said to live in seas and lakes. Even though it has no wings, it has been seen flying occasionally.

Dragonite.entry: It is said that this Pokémon lives somewhere in the sea and that it flies. However, it is only a rumor.

Mewtwo.entry: A Pokémon created by recombining Mew's genes. It's said to have the most savage heart among Pokémon.

Mew.entry: So rare that it is still said to be a mirage by many experts. Only a few people have seen it worldwide.
